newsitem.title: CHINA: China Yanshan Petrochemical sales $1.9 bln in 96.
newsitem.headline: China Yanshan Petrochemical sales $1.9 bln in 96.

text.p: China's state-owned Beijing Yanshan Petrochemical Corp achieved sales worth 16.2 billion yuan ($1.9 billion) in 1996, with pre-tax profits totalling 1.95 billion yuan, the China Economic Times said on Thursday.
The newspaper gave no comparative figures.
Yanshan planned to issue 'H' shares on the Hong Kong market representing 40 percent of its total assets, it said.
The company would list five of its chemical factories, which had total production capacity of 450,000 tonnes of ethylene, the newspaper said.
Yanshan held 5.5 billion yuan in fixed assets and 5.5 billion yuan in working assets, with total liabilities of around 6.0 billion yuan, state media said last year.
The company's ethylene output was expected to reach 500,000 tonnes in 1997, more than any other Chinese producer, the China Economic Times said.
Yanshan's annual oil refining capacity had reached 9.5 million tonnes, but there were no current plans to list its refinery business, it said but did not give further details.
